name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No tropical cyclones in the Atlantic; NHC puts the low south-east of Bermuda at near 0% for formation
state: The National Hurricane Center's outlook at 19:00 EST on 7 Nov showed no active tropical cyclones in the Atlantic. A non-tropical low several hundred miles south-south-east of Bermuda has a near 0% chance of formation through seven days and is expected to merge with a front within a day or two. The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: National Hurricane Center advisories are the official source for anyone in hurricane-prone areas.
rubric_hit: NHC: no cyclone active or threatening land within 5 days = Normal

sources.title: NOAA NHC — Atlantic Tropical Weather Outlook

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
rubric.normal: No hurricane active, or none threatening land within 5 days.
